dict.string: Voicy records your voice while you hold the push-to-talk key so it can transcribe it on-device.
Voicy uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice notes. Audio never leaves your Mac.
Voicy reads your contacts so it can match the name you speak to the right WhatsApp number. Contacts never leave your Mac.

Voicy watches for your push-to-talk key so dictation starts without clicking the menu bar. It looks only for that one key combination, only while Voicy is running, and keystrokes are never recorded or stored.
